name: Fortior
summary: Fortior Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shenzhen, researches, designs and develops integrated circuit chips for motor control, selling in Asia, North America and Europe. Its range includes ASICs, driver ICs, MOSFETs, MCUs and IPMs, used in industrial machinery, motion control, automotive parts, power tools, medical instruments, home appliances, consumer electronics, robotics and communications.
